title: I Followed the Haunted-House Wristband Into the Skip-the-Scream They Sold

parts.text: I scanned a general wristband at 8:19 p.m. and a skip-the-scream gate opened for a staff lanyard with no skip barcode. The posted map said: SKIP SCANS SKIP. GENERAL WALKS THE SWITCHBACK. Attendant Rico waved his cousins through on my time. I was twenty-seven, ticket holder, holding a still of the gate LED. "Lanyards are screams." I photographed the LED, the map, and the cousins' blank bands. Then I logged a skip sale. At 8:27 ops asked why Rico's lanyard was on a general gate. I waited where the camera already was.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: Ops can see Rico's cousins on blank bands through a skip gate on general time.

social.video_title: He waved cousins through skip on blank bands — Part 1/2
social.description: Haunted house, a general wristband, and a skip gate the attendant opened. I logged the sale. Would you have photographed the LED?

parts.text: Rico called it atmosphere until ops asked for the log. I printed the sale, the photo, and the map. The cousins walked the switchback. Rico scanned skip only when skip paid and told the line atmosphere was always about optics. Optics is a word attendants use when a blank band exists. Wristband policy now has a second line: LANYARDS ARE NOT SKIP. I keep the switchback. Rico scans. The house finally screams in order, not in cousins. I go back to being a person with a receipt. The second photo is for the person who will say they never saw the first.

social.description: Sale log, switchback cousins, and a second line. Was atmosphere ever a blank band?
